series.name: 2021 AUX Category-L subdivided failures (L0-L9, LA, LC)
series.notes: Category-L subdivided failure codes from the 2021 AUX troubleshooting guide (L0-L9, LA, LC) — controller display. High (service manual). Separate category from E/F/P schemes.

title.ur: DC ka over ya under voltage fail hona

meaning.en: The DC bus feeding the drive is outside its safe voltage band, so the drive refuses to run.
meaning.ur: Drive ko chalane wala DC bus apni mehfuz voltage range se bahar hai, is liye drive chalne se inkaar kar deta hai.

causes.en: Grid voltage genuinely too high or too low
causes.ur: Grid voltage waqai bohat zyada ya bohat kam hai

causes.en: Outdoor unit controller fault or rectifier/stage failure upstream
causes.ur: Outdoor unit controller fault hai ya upstream rectifier/stage fail hai

solutions.en: Measure the incoming supply and the DC bus before replacing anything
solutions.ur: Kuch badalne se pehle incoming supply aur DC bus measure karein.

solutions.en: Have the outdoor unit controller tested if the supply is healthy
solutions.ur: Agar supply theek hai to outdoor unit controller test karwaein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Primary troubleshooting parts per the manual are the outdoor unit controller and the power grid. The official US tables also carry L0 but word it differently per line - see the conflict notes.
notes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq primary troubleshooting parts outdoor unit controller aur power grid hain. Official US tables mein L0 bhi hai lekin har line par alag alfaz mein likha hai - conflict notes dekhein.

title.ur: Compressor phase current ki overcurrent protection

meaning.en: One compressor phase is drawing more current than allowed, so the drive stops.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki aik phase allowed se zyada current le rahi hai, is liye drive ruka.

causes.en: Damaged compressor or shorted winding
causes.ur: Compressor kharab hai ya winding short hai

causes.en: Grid disturbance, or a loose/burnt compressor wire
causes.ur: Grid mein disturbance hai, ya compressor wire dheela/jala hua hai

solutions.en: Check supply quality and the compressor wire terminations first
solutions.ur: Pehle supply quality aur compressor wire terminations check karein.

solutions.en: Measure compressor winding resistance and replace the compressor if it is shorted
solutions.ur: Compressor winding resistance measure karein aur agar short hai to compressor badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual lists outdoor controller, power grid, compressor and compressor wire as the parts to check.
notes.ur: Manual mein check karne ke liye outdoor controller, power grid, compressor aur compressor wire likhe hain.

meaning.en: The rotor position lost track of the commanded position during operation.
meaning.ur: Chalte waqt rotor ki position hukm di gayi position ke saath match kar nahi rahi.

causes.en: Damaged compressor
causes.ur: Compressor kharab ho gaya hai

causes.en: System pressure abnormal, or grid/controller disturbance
causes.ur: System pressure abnormal hai, ya grid/controller mein disturbance hai

solutions.en: Check system pressure and charge before condemning parts
solutions.ur: Parts ko kharab thehraiye se pehle system pressure aur charge check karein.

solutions.en: Test the compressor winding and the outdoor controller
solutions.ur: Compressor winding aur outdoor controller test karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Same underlying mechanical condition as F3, but reported as an L subdivision here.
notes.ur: Yeh F3 jaisi wahi underlying mechanical condition hai, lekin yahan L subdivision ke tor par report ki gayi hai.

meaning.en: One compressor phase is missing or not being driven.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki aik phase mojood nahi hai ya use chalaya nahi ja raha.

causes.en: Compressor power line not connected or burnt
causes.ur: Compressor power line connect nahi hai ya jala hua hai

causes.en: Damaged compressor, or outdoor controller/driver fault
causes.ur: Compressor kharab hai, ya outdoor controller/driver fault hai

solutions.en: Inspect and re-torque the compressor power connections
solutions.ur: Compressor power connections check karke dobara sahi torque se kasein.

solutions.en: Test the outdoor controller if the wiring is sound
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek hai to outdoor controller test karein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual parts list - outdoor controller, power grid, compressor, compressor wire.
notes.ur: Manual ki parts list - outdoor controller, power grid, compressor aur compressor wire.

title.ur: Compressor driver module IPM ka kharab hona

meaning.en: The intelligent power module that drives the compressor is reporting an internal failure.
meaning.ur: Jo intelligent power module compressor ko chalata hai woh andaruni kharabi dikha raha hai.

causes.en: IPM module itself damaged, often after overcurrent or overheating
causes.ur: IPM module khud kharab ho gaya hai, aksar overcurrent ya overheating ke baad

causes.en: Grid disturbance or a failing outdoor unit controller feeding it badly
causes.ur: Grid disturbance ya outdoor unit controller ka fail hona jo theek se supply nahi deta

solutions.en: Check supply quality and the compressor for a short before replacing the module
solutions.ur: Module badalne se pehle supply quality aur compressor mein short ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the IPM/module board after the compressor and wiring have been cleared
solutions.ur: Compressor aur wiring theek hone ke baad IPM/module board badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual parts list - outdoor unit controller, power grid, compressor.
notes.ur: Manual ki parts list - outdoor unit controller, power grid aur compressor.

meaning.en: Hardware-level current limit in the PFC stage tripped.
meaning.ur: PFC stage ka hardware level current limit trip ho gaya.

causes.en: PFC stage components damaged
causes.ur: PFC stage ke components kharab hain

causes.en: Grid voltage or inrush conditions outside design limits
causes.ur: Grid voltage ya inrush conditions design limits se bahar hain

solutions.en: Measure supply voltage and check for surge damage
solutions.ur: Supply voltage measure karein aur surge damage ke liye check karein.

solutions.en: Have the PFC stage and outdoor controller tested
solutions.ur: PFC stage aur outdoor controller test karwaein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Hardware counterpart of L6 - keep the two apart when logging faults.
notes.ur: Yeh L6 ka hardware counterpart hai - faults log karte waqt dono ko alag rakhein.

meaning.en: The control software detected sustained overcurrent in the PFC stage and shut it down.
meaning.ur: Control software ne PFC stage mein lambe arse ka overcurrent detect kiya aur usay band kar diya.

causes.en: Sustained overcurrent from supply conditions
causes.ur: Supply conditions ki wajah se lagataar overcurrent hai

causes.en: Degraded PFC components drawing more current than expected
causes.ur: PFC components degrade hone se expected se zyada current le rahe hain

solutions.en: Check the supply quality over a full run cycle
solutions.ur: Poore ek run cycle mein supply quality check karein.

solutions.en: Have a technician test the PFC components and outdoor controller
solutions.ur: Technician se PFC components aur outdoor controller test karwaein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.ur: Yeh L5 ka software counterpart hai.

meaning.en: The current sensing circuit itself reported an implausible reading, so the drive stopped rather than trust it.
meaning.ur: Current sensing circuit ne khud hi ajeeb reading di, is liye drive ne us par bharosa karne ke bajaye ruk kar rakh diya.

causes.en: Outdoor unit controller fault in the sensing path
causes.ur: Outdoor unit controller ke sensing path mein fault hai

causes.en: Shunt, wiring or ADC issue on the controller
causes.ur: Controller par shunt, wiring ya ADC ka masla hai

solutions.en: Have the outdoor unit controller's current sensing checked
solutions.ur: Outdoor unit controller ki current sensing check karwaein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor controller if the reading cannot be corrected
solutions.ur: Agar reading theek na ho sake to outdoor controller badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual names the outdoor unit controller as the sole part to check.
notes.ur: Manual sirf outdoor unit controller ko hi check karne ka ekmatr part batata hai.

meaning.en: The current-sense shunt resistors do not match each other, so measurements cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: Current sense ke shunt resistors aapas mein match nahi karte, is liye in par bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta.

causes.en: Aged or damaged shunt resistors on the controller
causes.ur: Controller ke shunt resistors purane ya kharab hain

causes.en: Controller board fault
causes.ur: Controller board ka fault hai

solutions.en: Have the shunt network measured on the outdoor controller
solutions.ur: Outdoor controller par shunt network measure karwaein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor unit controller if the imbalance persists
solutions.ur: Agar imbalance barqarar rahe to outdoor unit controller badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual names the outdoor unit controller as the sole part to check.
notes.ur: Manual sirf outdoor unit controller ko hi check karne ka ekmatr part batata hai.

title.ur: IPM ka temperature sensor fail hona

meaning.en: The temperature sensor inside the power module reads out of range, so thermal protection cannot be trusted.
meaning.ur: Power module ke andar ka temperature sensor range se bahar parh raha hai, is liye thermal protection par bharosa nahi.

causes.en: IPM temperature sensor damaged or poorly coupled to the heatsink
causes.ur: IPM temperature sensor kharab hai ya heatsink par theek se attach nahi hai

causes.en: Outdoor unit controller/module board fault
causes.ur: Outdoor unit controller/module board ka fault hai

solutions.en: Check the sensor and its mounting against the heatsink
solutions.ur: Sensor aur heatsink ke sath uski mounting check karein.

solutions.en: Replace the module board if the reading stays out of range
solutions.ur: Agar reading out-of-range hi rahe to module board badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual names the outdoor unit controller as the part to check.
notes.ur: Manual outdoor unit controller ko check karne ke liye part batata hai.

meaning.en: The compressor could not be brought up from standstill in the allowed time.
meaning.ur: Compressor ko muaqqal waqt ke andar chalu karaya nahi ja saka.

causes.en: Compressor stuck or winding damaged
causes.ur: Compressor atak gaya hai ya winding kharab hai

causes.en: Compressor wire not properly connected, or grid voltage sag during start
causes.ur: Compressor wire theek se connect nahi hai, ya start ke waqt grid voltage sag karta hai

solutions.en: Check the compressor terminals and supply voltage during a start attempt
solutions.ur: Start karne ki koshish ke waqt compressor terminals aur supply voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Test the winding and replace the compressor if it will not turn over
solutions.ur: Winding test karein aur agar compressor turn na ho to compressor badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Manual parts list - outdoor unit controller, power grid, compressor, compressor wire.
notes.ur: Manual ki parts list - outdoor unit controller, power grid, compressor aur compressor wire.

title.en: Abnormal protection in PFC current detection
title.ur: PFC current detection ka abnormal protection

meaning.en: The PFC current measurement reads implausibly, so protection trips instead of trusting it.
meaning.ur: PFC current measurement ka reading ajeeb aata hai, is liye bharosa karne ke bajaye protection trip kar deti hai.

causes.en: Outdoor unit controller fault in the PFC sensing path
causes.ur: Outdoor unit controller ke PFC sensing path mein fault hai

causes.en: Component drift on the controller board
causes.ur: Controller board par component drift hai

solutions.en: Have the outdoor controller's PFC sensing measured
solutions.ur: Outdoor controller ki PFC sensing measure karwaein.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor unit controller if it cannot be corrected
solutions.ur: Agar theek na ho sake to outdoor unit controller badal dein.

source.title: Troubleshooting Guide & Error Codes AUX Brand 2021 (Macroclima / AUX) - Category-L subdivided failures

notes.en: Distinct from L5/L6, which are the PFC overcurrent hardware and software trips themselves. Manual names the outdoor unit controller as the part to check.
notes.ur: Yeh L5/L6 se alag hai jo khud PFC overcurrent ke hardware aur software trips hain. Manual outdoor unit controller ko check karne ke liye part batata hai.
